reproduction.method: Beta-binomial predictive enumeration and grid-based shortest posterior intervals
reproduction.description: Computes the predictive probability that a uniform-analysis-prior 95% Beta posterior HDI meets a precision target.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
512-cell midpoint quadrature and shortest contiguous interval replace betainv/fminbnd HDIs; widths have resolution 1/512 and are explicitly approximate.
Retains N=1,6,…,96 and original design means/strengths/widths, but shows selected combinations instead of every figure.
Only the active width goal is implemented; no null-exclusion branch or frequentist-power relabeling.
